_note: Live trade-zone settings for the STOCK bot (owner 2026-10-14: live, forward-tested). The 2-hour optimizer edits this file (values only within the frozen grid), then deploys. intraday = ab- scalp/day bot, swing = sw- bot.

ladder._note: owner 2026-10-14 (drawing): buy once risking 1% of equity (the stop = the 'All' line); against the trade sell 25% half way to the stop and 50% in all at three quarters, the stop takes the rest; in the take-profit zone sell 25% at the zone (stop to break-even) and 50% in all 0.25 ATR beyond (stop locked at the zone); the rest rides the trend (expert's fixed target off). Repeats while the stock trends (up to 3 trades per stock per day). The riding part is followed by a virtual stop 1 ATR behind its best price.

mtf._note: owner 2026-10-15: trend direction AND strength confirmed on weekly / 1-hour / 15-minute before entry, and re-checked while the trade runs (the 1-hour trend turning against a trend-expert trade exits it at the next open). Range experts need a NON-trending 1-hour market. Set entry / trend_exit to false to switch a part off.

box._note: owner 2026-10-16: the range box as its own strategy, LIVE without waiting for the test (paper). Weinstein stage, direction and multi-timeframe checks apply as for every expert; buy zone = bottom third of the daily box, stop 0.5 daily ATR outside it, take-profit = far edge less 0.25 daily ATR, cuts and TP steps as drawn. Set live to false to switch it off.

fib._note: owner 2026-10-16: the range box with Fibonacci zones, LIVE on paper at reduced size without a backtest (his decision). Buy zone 0.618-0.786 retracement of the daily box, stop 0.25 daily ATR beyond the box edge, TP1 at the 0.5 level, TP2 at the 0.236 level, drawn cuts and rider. risk_pct = share of equity risked per trade (0.005 = 0.5%, half the normal 1%). Set live to false to switch it off.

hybrid._note: owner 2026-10-16: HYBRID zones (range box + Fibonacci levels + the stock's swing levels; the entry is where they agree), LIVE on paper at reduced size without a backtest (his decision). Rules in zonemap.HYBRID_RULES; stop 0.5 ATR past the entry level, TP1 the first target >= 1R, TP2 the next >= 0.5R beyond. Tag hybrid_box. Set live to false to switch it off.

box_confirm._note: owner 2026-10-16 ('fix the box: candlesticks, volume, volatility'): a close outside the stock's daily box is traded WITH the break only when the continuation indicators agree (body, close location, volume >= 1.5x, volatility >= 1.1x, decisive close; vote = share that must agree). The fade side lost in every test, so mode = continuation. LIVE on paper at half size by the owner's decision. Set live to false to switch it off.

trend_confirm._note: owner 2026-10-16: trend experts (velez_elephant, raschke_grail, brooks_pullback, donchian_turtle) enter only when the signal bar shows the trend continuing: at least `vote` of 5 checks agree (body, close location, volume >= vol_mult x 20-bar avg, volatility >= session average, follow-through past the previous bar). A filter only: it removes entries, never adds them. Set live to false to switch it off.
